uno: A fan of colorful playing cards in red, yellow, green and blue bursts out of a hand toward the viewer, with curved arrows and plain bold symbols flying around them. A bright party table in the background, energetic diagonal composition, warm cheerful light. Hand-painted board game box cover illustration with flat bold shapes and saturated colors.
quiz: A round game token with six colored wedges sits at the center of a cheerful circular board path with six colored zones, surrounded by floating question marks and small colorful props. A bright quiz show stage with soft spotlights behind it. Hand-painted board game box cover illustration, vivid saturated colors, centered composition.
trono: A king, a queen, a jester and a hooded assassin stand around a pile of playing cards on a stone floor, with an empty golden throne rising behind them. A candlelit medieval throne room with bare stone walls and long shadows, moody red and gold light. Hand-painted board game box cover illustration, dramatic and detailed.
giallo: A detective in a long coat stands in the doorway of a 1930s dining room where an elegant table is set with candelabra, a spilled glass of red wine and one overturned chair. The guests' long shadows stretch across the bare green wall. Warm candlelight against deep green darkness, noir mood. Hand-painted board game box cover illustration.
serata: A grand manor hall with a very long banquet table set for dozens of guests, grouped under three colors of drapery, red, blue and gold, with crystal chandeliers overhead. A cloaked figure lingers in the shadows at the far end. Rich burgundy and gold light, mystery atmosphere. Hand-painted board game box cover illustration, wide depth.
avventura: Four fantasy heroes stand on a hilltop at dawn, looking over a vast kingdom that unfolds like a map below them, with a broken golden crown lying on the grass in front of them. Warm sunrise light, rolling green land, rivers and distant towers. Hand-painted board game box cover illustration, epic painterly landscape.
scoundrel: A lone rogue with a drawn sword walks down a dark dungeon corridor, with playing cards floating in the air around him like weapons and potions, and goblin eyes glowing in the shadows ahead. A single torch lights the stone walls with orange fire against dark teal. Hand-painted board game box cover illustration, roguelike mood.
machiavelli: A scheming nobleman in dark red Renaissance robes leans over a long table covered with neat sets and runs of playing cards in a Florentine palace room. Candlelight, deep burgundy and olive tones, bare plaster walls with carved arches. Hand-painted oil painting style board game box cover illustration.
regix: A vampire in a cape, a stone golem, a forest spirit made of branches and an undead skeleton knight surround one glowing playing card on a dark ground, each lit by its own color of light: red, orange, green and violet. Dark fantasy mood with deep shadows. Hand-painted board game box cover illustration, richly detailed.
rlegacy: Twelve lit candles stand in a row on a stone table in front of a crumbling castle under a stormy sky, beside a worn campaign map and a small chest closed with a red wax seal. Heroes in the distance slowly turn dark. Cold blue storm light with warm candle glow. Hand-painted board game box cover illustration, dramatic.
spie: Two spymasters in trench coats face each other across a table with a grid of twenty five blank cards, some covered with red and blue agent tokens, next to a magnifying glass and a fedora. The scene is split between cold red and blue light, cold war spy noir. Hand-painted board game box cover illustration.
zucca: Teams act out a chaotic party game in a bright living room: one mimes, one draws on a big sheet of paper, one sings into a spoon and one shouts a riddle, all with goofy expressive faces and confetti in the air. Flat bold shapes, saturated colors, comedic mood. Hand-painted board game box cover illustration.
fantasma: A hooded ghostly fugitive hides in the fog of Victorian London at night while detectives with lanterns close in, with a hansom taxi, a double decker bus and a tube station entrance around them. Moody blue and amber gaslight, wet cobblestones. Hand-painted board game box cover illustration, atmospheric.
